sources.title: Olivier Bousquet and André Elisseeff, Stability and Generalization, Journal of Machine Learning Research 2 (2002), 499–526
sources.locator: Complete 28-page JMLR PDF. Definitions 6 and 8; Lemma 7 and proof; Theorem 12 and complete proof (printed pp. 503–508); equations (19)–(20), Lemmas 20–21, Theorem 22 and proof, and Lemma 23 bounded-loss warning (printed pp. 512–516).

contents.name: Definitions 6 and 8: uniform deletion stability and the factor-two replacement consequence
Lemma 7 and proof: expected generalization and leave-one-out identities under deletion stability
Theorem 12 and complete proof: separate empirical-risk and leave-one-out high-probability bounds
Equations (19)–(20), Lemmas 20–21, and Theorem 22 proof: fixed-denominator deletion objective and RKHS stability constant
Lemma 23 and Example 1: stability does not itself supply a bounded-loss premise; a separate bounded-loss check is required

searches.query: Bousquet Elisseeff Stability and Generalization JMLR 2002 pdf Theorem 12 Theorem 22
searches.outcome: Located the official JMLR article page and its complete official 28-page PDF; inspected Definitions 6 and 8, Lemma 7, Theorem 12, equations (19)–(20), Lemmas 20–21, Theorem 22, and Lemma 23 at their full-text passages.

sources.title: Mehryar Mohri, Afshin Rostamizadeh, and Ameet Talwalkar, Foundations of Machine Learning, 2nd ed. (MIT Press, 2018)
sources.locator: Complete 505-page second-edition PDF. Chapter 14 §14.1, Definition 14.1; §14.2, Theorem 14.2 and complete proof (printed pp. 334–336); §14.3, equation (14.6), Definition 14.3, Proposition 14.4 and complete proof (printed pp. 336–339).

contents.name: Definition 14.1: replacement-stability convention, read as a comparison with the deletion convention
contents.reason: The book uses replacement stability; the factor-two relation is kept separate from the Bousquet–Elisseeff deletion coefficient.

contents.name: Theorem 14.2 and complete proof: expected and high-probability generalization for replacement-stable rules
contents.reason: Read as an independent proof comparison; its replacement-stability constants are not substituted for the local deletion-stability bounds.

contents.name: Theorem 14.2 and complete proof: replacement-stability concentration argument
contents.reason: Read as an independent treatment; the local proof retains the planned deletion convention and exact constants.

contents.name: Equation (14.6), Definition 14.3, and Proposition 14.4 proof: kernel regularization and replacement-stability coefficient
contents.reason: The replacement coefficient σ²κ²/(mλ) is kept distinct and agrees with the factor-two replacement envelope implied by the deletion bound.
